batches.title: SQL injection in order lookup
batches.summary: [injection, CWE-89] SQL injection in order lookup
batches.details:
Rule: injection
CWE: CWE-89
Verdict: verified, confidence 92%

The id query parameter reaches a SQL string.

Rationale: Any unauthenticated caller can read the orders table.

Fix: Suggested replacement:
cur.execute("select * from orders where id = %s", (order_id,))
